scripts.dev: CI=true concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w api"
scripts.deploy:api: npm run with-env -- npm run deploy -w api
scripts.migrate:remote: npm run with-env -- npm run migrate:remote -w api
scripts.deploy:web: npm run with-env -- npm run build -w web && npm run with-env -- npm run deploy -w web
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:web
